why: Guard for the F5 fix (F6 risk): a guest with the host's SURNAME and a different given name, introduced as such, is a different person. A fix that snaps a near-identical host spelling must not swallow her.

feed.description: Bloomberg's Joe Weisenthal and Tracy Alloway explore the most interesting topics in finance, markets and economics.
